h1: Custom Box Mints for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom box mints in bulk with your logo. Perfect for offices, events, and client gifts. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Box mints offer a convenient and professional way to keep your brand top-of-mind. Unlike tins or pouches, a box provides ample space for your logo or message on a flat, uncurved surface, ensuring maximum visibility. Whether you choose soft peppermints for a refreshing pick-me-up or buttermints for a classic treat, custom box mints are ideal for reception desks, break rooms, and client meetings. They are easy to stack, store, and distribute, making them a practical choice for bulk orders.
heroAltText: Custom box mints with logo imprint, assorted colors and flavors displayed on a desk
